turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son see a zero before I got a phone call?
Hey! Glad you made it, parking here is a nightmare.
I didn't come to talk about parking. The phone call, Hale.
Love the coat, by the way.
Spare me. Who decided on the zero, and on what?
Okay so, I'm thinking we keep this super chill. You seem like a super chill person.
Super chill. My son found out from his phone in the middle of class, and you want chill. Answer the question.
